details:
PROJECT AURORA is an interactive 3D educational space mission simulation game developed by Team MathaiBlock for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 under the Space Mission Design Game challenge.

The project transforms complex concepts in space science, planetary exploration, and aerospace engineering into an engaging, hands-on learning experience. Players take command of the Odyssey 07 spacecraft and progress through different mission stages, including spacecraft design, launch, interplanetary navigation, orbital maneuvers, hazard management, planetary exploration, and scientific sample collection.

The game features five destinations: Earth, the Moon, Mars, the Asteroid Belt, and Europa. Each destination introduces different environmental conditions, scientific objectives, and mission challenges. Players apply concepts such as the Tsiolkovsky rocket equation, fuel and mass management, orbital mechanics, planetary environments, and scientific observation while completing missions.

A key feature is the integration of authentic NASA and JPL mission resources, planetary datasets, and space science information through a custom-built NASA Mission Data API. The game also includes a four-player collaborative mode, allowing participants to take different mission-control roles and work together to accomplish objectives.

The project was developed using JavaScript, Three.js, WebGL, HTML, CSS, and the Web Audio API, with a custom REST API built to retrieve and organize scientific data. It combines immersive 3D visualization, interactive simulations, educational gameplay, and collaborative problem-solving.

Our goal is to make space science and aerospace engineering more accessible, encourage curiosity about planetary exploration, and provide an interactive learning environment where players can understand scientific concepts by applying them in simulated missions.
